name: Crafty Slider
body:
You are quick to find and enjoy slides in any environment.

Prerequisites: Character level 5th, otterling.

Benefit: You gain slow fall 20 feet, as the monk class feature. Your slow fall distance increases by 5 feet for every 2 character levels you possess beyond 5th. This ability stacks with the slow fall class feature, up to 120 feet.
